reason: Alphabet's Q3 primary documents materially updated the canonical AI-capex and cash-conversion analysis. The verified existing-content update passed its applicable gates, merged at the expected head and is live at the stable canonical URL.
story_thesis: Google Cloud's operating growth strengthened while Alphabet's quarterly free-cash-flow deficit widened because property-and-equipment purchases rose faster than operating cash flow.

evidence_table.claim: Q3 revenue was USD127.577bn and operating income was USD40.576bn.
evidence_table.location: Q3 2026 financial highlights and consolidated results
evidence_table.result: Confirmed as GAAP consolidated figures for the three months ended 30 September 2026.

evidence_table.claim: Google Cloud revenue was USD30.709bn, up 103%, and segment operating income was USD11.121bn versus USD3.594bn.
evidence_table.arithmetic: 11.121 / 30.709 = 36.2141% Q3 Cloud operating margin; 3.594 / 15.157 = 23.7118% prior-year margin.
evidence_table.result: Confirmed; segment profit is not described as standalone free cash flow.

evidence_table.claim: Quarterly operating cash flow was USD42.290bn, property-and-equipment purchases were USD51.355bn and company-defined free cash flow was negative USD9.065bn.
evidence_table.location: Reconciliation from GAAP net cash provided by operating activities to non-GAAP free cash flow
evidence_table.result: Confirmed; the article labels free cash flow as Alphabet's definition.

evidence_table.claim: Q2 free cash flow was negative USD5.855bn and the Q3 deficit widened by USD3.210bn.
evidence_table.result: Confirmed as a sequential comparison, not an annual cash-flow claim.

evidence_table.claim: Trailing-twelve-month free cash flow remained positive at USD19.747bn.
evidence_table.result: Confirmed; explicitly kept distinct from the negative quarter.

evidence_table.claim: Nine-month operating cash flow was USD127.149bn and property-and-equipment purchases were USD131.953bn, implying negative USD4.804bn after the same subtraction.
evidence_table.result: Confirmed as Compound arithmetic using GAAP cash-flow lines, not a separately reported nine-month non-GAAP figure.

evidence_table.claim: Nine-month capital expenditure more than doubled from USD63.596bn; assets not yet in service were USD145.270bn versus USD78.592bn at year-end 2025 and may take months to years to enter service.
evidence_table.location: Cash-flow statement; property-and-equipment note; capital-expenditure MD&A
evidence_table.result: Confirmed; assets not yet in service are primarily technical infrastructure.

evidence_table.claim: At unchanged Q3 operating cash flow, purchases would need to fall 17.7% for free cash flow to reach zero; at unchanged purchases, operating cash flow would need to rise 21.4%.
evidence_table.location: Compound sensitivity using the reported Q3 cash-flow reconciliation
evidence_table.result: Recomputed independently and labelled as sensitivity, not guidance.

evidence_table.claim: Alphabet expects 2026 technical-infrastructure investment to increase significantly from 2025; Cloud profit growth was partly offset by TPU-system inventory costs and technical-infrastructure usage costs.
evidence_table.location: Capital Expenditures and Leases; Google Cloud MD&A
evidence_table.result: Confirmed as management commentary and cost attribution, not Compound guidance.
